text.mine-lights.about.title: MineLights
text.mine-lights.about.support_intro: If you enjoy this mod, please consider supporting its development:
text.mine-lights.about.kofi: Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi
text.mine-lights.about.description: MineLights is a Minecraft mod that brings RGB lighting integrations to Minecraft Java Edition.
option.mine-lights.enableMod.tooltip: Toggles all lighting effects from the mod.
option.mine-lights.manualServerManagemen:
When enabled, the mod does not download or replace MineLights Server.
It can still start a server you installed when Automatically Start Server is enabled.
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer: Notify when MineLights Server is missing
option.mine-lights.notifyMissingServer.t:
In manual server management mode, shows an in-game installation
message when MineLights Server is missing.
option.mine-lights.checkServerUpdates.to:
In manual server management mode, checks for releases and shows
new versions and their changelog in chat. Install updates manually.
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.label: Refresh Device List
option.mine-lights.refresh_devices.toolt:
If you plug in a new device while the game is running,
check this and save to make it appear in the list.
option.mine-lights.restart.label: Restart Server
option.mine-lights.restart_admin.label: Restart Server as Administrator
option.mine-lights.device.header: Enable or disable specific lighting devices below:
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.label: Re-enable All Devices
option.mine-lights.clear_disabled.toolti: Check this box to clear the list of all disabled devices.
option.mine-lights.enableSaturationBar.t:
Shows your food saturation on %s.
Switches to your air level when underwater.
Change the keys in Key Layout.
option.mine-lights.enableLocatorBar.tool:
Shows other players and waypoints in front of you as coloured dots on %s.
Change the keys in Key Layout.
option.mine-lights.alwaysShowCompass.too:
If enabled, the compass effect will always show the standard compass
(pointing to world spawn), even if you don't have one.
It will be overridden if you pick up any compass.
option.mine-lights.compassPriority.toolt: Determines which compass to display if multiple types are in your inventory.
option.mine-lights.highlightMovementKeys: Highlights WASD, Sprint, Sneak, and Jump keys.
option.mine-lights.pulseChatKey.tooltip: Makes the chat key flash three times when a message is received
option.mine-lights.enableBiomeEffects.to: Sets a base keyboard colour based on the biome you are in.
option.mine-lights.dimmingMode.tooltip: Choose how environmental effects are dimmed based on light levels.
Adds rain and thunderstorm lighting effects.
option.mine-lights.mirrorRamRainDirectio: Reverses the rain animation direction on RAM devices.
Replicates the purple flash effect that occurs in the End dimension.
option.mine-lights.enableInWaterEffect.t: Highlights movement keys with a blue colour when submerged.
option.mine-lights.lodestoneCompassShimm:
Plays the purple shimmer across the compass keys while you use a lodestone compass.
When off, the keys keep the lodestone colours without the animation.
option.mine-lights.force_update.label: Check for Server Update
option.mine-lights.force_update.tooltip:
Checks GitHub for a MineLights Server update.
Automatic management can download updates; manual management shows installation details in chat.
text.mine-lights.server.restart_from_tra: The V2 server is shared with other clients and software. Restart or stop it from its system tray menu.
option.mine-lights.minBrightness.tooltip:
Minimum brightness for environmental effects when dimming is enabled.
0 = completely dark; 1 = full brightness.
text.mine-lights.key_layout.help: Choose which keys each effect lights up. Click "+ Add keys", then press the keys on your keyboard in order (the first key is the start of the bar), and press Esc when you're done. Changes apply when you click Save.
option.mine-lights.effectConfigHelp: Enter key names separated by commas and colours as #RRGGBB. LED overrides use Device name|index=KEY; separate multiple overrides with semicolons. Use none to clear a list or profile.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.tooltip:
Keys that show your health, from empty to full.
Your 20 health is split evenly across the keys.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.tooltip: Keys that show your hunger, from empty to full.
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.too: Keys that show saturation, or air while underwater.
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.too:
Keys that show progress towards your next level.
Each key fills up gradually.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.tool:
Keys that pulse like a heartbeat when your health is low.
Default draws a heart shape in the middle of the keyboard.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.to:
Keys that pulse white along with the heartbeat.
Default is the shine on the heart (R Y G).
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.tooltip:
Keys around the compass, clockwise starting from straight ahead.
Usually 8 keys; any number works.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.tool: Key in the middle of the compass ring.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.tooltip:
Rename LEDs a device reports wrongly.
Format: Device name|LED index=KEY
Example: Keychron|1=F1
Device name matches any device whose name contains it.
LED indexes are in the game log.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.toolti:
Keys used for the locator bar, left to right.
The middle key is straight ahead; the ends are 60 degrees to each side.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.toolti:
How many keys a dot bleeds over, for the closest waypoints.
Farther waypoints get smaller dots, in the same 4 steps as the vanilla bar. 0.5 to 5.
option.mine-lights.restoreLightingOutsid:
On the title screen, while loading, or after quitting,
hand OpenRGB devices back to your normal lighting.
Off: everything turns red outside of a world.
option.mine-lights.outsideWorldProfile.t:
Name of an OpenRGB profile to load outside of a world
(save one in OpenRGB with your usual lighting).
Leave blank to restore the mode each device had when MineLights connected.
option.mine-lights.experienceLocatorMode:
Merged: works exactly like the bar above your hotbar. The keys show
the experience bar whenever the screen does (no one tracked, or for a
few seconds after you gain XP) and the locator bar the rest of the time.
Both: locator dots are drawn on top of the experience bar.
option.mine-lights.enableAbsorptionOverl:
Absorption hearts (golden apple, enchanted golden apple, totem)
turn the health keys gold, from the start of the bar,
one key per the same amount of health as a red key.
option.mine-lights.lowHealthThreshold.to:
The low health heartbeat starts below this much health.
2 health = 1 heart. Default 10 (5 hearts).
text.mine-lights.keys.none: No keys: this effect won't show anywhere.
text.mine-lights.keys.capturing: Press keys in order, Esc when done: %s
text.mine-lights.keys.unknown: %s isn't a normal key (media keys aren't). If your keyboard has an Fn key, hold it to press F1-F12.
option.mine-lights.healthBarKeys.descrip: Fills red with your health; golden hearts turn keys gold. Flashes white when you're hit, grey when withering, yellow-green when poisoned.
option.mine-lights.hungerBarKeys.descrip: Fills orange with your food level (20 drumsticks split across the keys).
option.mine-lights.saturationBarKeys.des: Lime with your hidden saturation; turns light blue and shows your air while your head is underwater and until it refills. Not used if saturation is merged into the hunger bar (Player Status).
option.mine-lights.experienceBarKeys.des: Fills green as you earn experience and resets when you level up.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarKeys.descri: Other players and waypoints in front of you show as dots in their own locator bar colour, on a dark bar like in game. Brighter means up, darker means down.
option.mine-lights.locatorDotSize.descri: Bigger dots glow onto more neighboring keys. Like the vanilla bar, dots shrink in 4 steps between 128 and 332 blocks away; past that they are a single key.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatRedKeys.desc: Pulses in the heartbeat colour below the Low Health Threshold (Player Status). The default keys form a heart: 4 5 6 7 / E T U / D F H / V B / Space.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatWhiteKeys.de: White shine drawn on top of the heart while it pulses.
option.mine-lights.compassKeys.descripti: When you hold a compass, the key in the target's direction lights up. Press the ring keys clockwise starting from the one for straight ahead. Default: numpad 8 9 6 3 2 1 4 7.
option.mine-lights.compassCenterKey.desc: Shows the compass colour, and pulses when you're within 8 blocks of the target. Default: numpad 5.
option.mine-lights.ledOverrides.descript: Only needed when a device names an LED wrongly, like a keyboard whose F1 reports as "Brightness Down". LED numbers are in the game log (logs/latest.log).
text.mine-lights.colors.help: Each bar fades from its empty colour to its full colour as it fills.
option.mine-lights.absorptionColor.toolt: Colour of health keys covered by absorption (golden) hearts.
option.mine-lights.airColor.tooltip: Saturation keys while underwater, for air you still have.
option.mine-lights.airDimColor.tooltip: Saturation keys while underwater, for air you've used up.
option.mine-lights.experienceDimColor.to: Experience keys when not filled yet.
option.mine-lights.heartbeatColor.toolti: Colour of the low health heartbeat at its brightest.
option.mine-lights.saturationTintStrengt:
How much saturation tints the hunger keys when merged.
0 = no tint, 1 = full saturation colour. Default 0.25.
option.mine-lights.mergeSaturationIntoHu: Merge Saturation & Air into Hunger Bar

Shows saturation and air on the hunger keys instead of their own keys.
Saturation tints the hunger keys it covers (like AppleSkin).
Underwater, and until your air refills, the hunger keys show air instead,
like the bubbles that appear above the hunger bar.
The Saturation / Air keys are left free.
option.mine-lights.locatorBarColor.toolt:
Colour of the locator keys behind the waypoint dots
(the dark bar you see in game).
option.mine-lights.notifyServerDownloadP: Notify me about MineLights Server downloads
Shows chat messages when a server download starts in a world, continues after you join a world, and finishes.
message.minelights.server.download.in_pr: [MineLights] MineLights Server download is still in progress.
message.minelights.server.download.finis: [MineLights] MineLights Server download finished and the server has started.
[MineLights] MineLights Server update finished and the server has restarted.
message.minelights.server.download.resta: [MineLights] The MineLights Server update is verified but not installed yet. If a MineLights Server is running, stop it from its system tray; then restart Minecraft to install and start the update.
message.minelights.server.download.start: [MineLights] MineLights Server could not be started automatically. Start it from its tray or install it manually: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.download.faile: [MineLights] Automatic MineLights Server setup could not be completed. If the server is running, stop it from its tray; otherwise install it manually: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
message.minelights.server.update_check_f: [MineLights] MineLights Server update check failed. Review updates manually: https://github.com/megabytesme/MineLights-Server/releases
